title: 1% on Your Mortgage Rate = $94,700
text:
On a $400,000 30-year fixed loan, the principal-and-interest payment is about $2,398 at 6% and $2,661 at 7%: $263 more a month, about $94,700 more over the loan. Taxes and insurance are extra. Comparing Loan Estimates from several lenders is how buyers find a better rate. Education, not financial advice.

Save this before you talk to a lender.

Educational only. Talk to a licensed lender for your situation.
